title: Next Avengers: Heroes of Tomorrow
synopsis: Tony Stark raises the children of fallen Avengers in hiding. When James activates robotic copies of their parents, Ultron traces the machines back to their home and captures Tony.
verdictRationale: Tony spends years doing a guardian’s work after the other Avengers fall. The children in turn risk themselves for him. Avenging their parents gives the fighting an angry edge, but freeing the person who raised them gives them a purpose that defeating an enemy alone could never fulfill.
ageRationale: Repeated robot battles and the threat of losing a second caregiver give this adventure weight for a child. Children who have lost a parent may find Tony’s capture harder than the fighting.
reflection: Tony’s armor buys the children time to escape. Long before that moment, his daily care gave them someone to come home to. Which form of service would be easier for a bystander to miss?

themes.name: Faithful care
themes.evidence: Tony’s years as guardian establish the family bond behind the rescue and explain why his capture matters.

themes.name: Courage in service
themes.evidence: The young heroes enter Ultron’s city and join forces with Francis to bring Tony out. Courage serves a particular person at risk.

themes.name: Vengeance
themes.evidence: The children face the killer of their parents. The wish to avenge them accompanies the conflict, though their immediate rescue mission gives them another reason to act.

title: Planet Hulk

sources.label: Arlington Heights Memorial Library DVD record

synopsis: Exiled to Sakaar, Hulk is enslaved and made to fight for the Red King. The other captives begin to regard him as one of their own.
verdictRationale: The captives’ refusal to abandon Hulk gives their fellowship moral force. The arena exposes a ruler who treats persons as property. Yet the film also invites viewers to enjoy the same punishing blows that entertain an arena crowd. Families have reason to admire the prisoners’ loyalty and to question that pleasure.
ageRationale: Sustained animated combat includes severed bodies and bloody blows to a fallen opponent. Creatures invade victims’ bodies. These sequences warrant older-teen guidance even for viewers familiar with lighter Hulk adventures.
reflection: Hulk’s companions offer him a place among them while he still wants to stand alone. Their patience raises a question a contest of strength cannot answer: how does someone learn to receive another person’s care?

themes.name: Solidarity
themes.evidence: Miek and the other captives claim Hulk as one of their own and persist when he withdraws. Belonging changes what escape would mean.

themes.name: Domination
themes.evidence: The Red King’s regime sells captives into arena combat. Coercion is the premise for the entire gladiator story.
